Comment from the circle (teacher)/Details

The male protagonist has taken possession of the body of his childhood friend, Miyako Sumeba. He has the mind of a boy, but the body of a girl. This is the third volume of the story in which he uses his mysterious body, which unconsciously transforms parts of his body into male form, to search for a girl at school who will become his mother.
